ITEM 1 | Dark green, finely curled and ruffled leafy pieces with crinkled edges and a matte, slightly glossy sheen. Loosely piled in a mound about 15 cm across in the lower-right of the plate, with some darker and lighter green variation. Pieces are fresh-looking and hold their shape, with no visible browning or cooking marks. | 35

ITEM 2 | Thin, flat, pale beige-tan shavings and slivers, about 1 to 3 cm long, scattered over and between the green leaves. They look dry with a smooth, slightly translucent surface and no visible browning. | 6
